messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager P1: Dedicated EU autoscaler thrash detected for pool 'dedicated-eu-1' — sustained task churn causing request queuing. Alert at 2026-05-12T08:02:57Z.
Priya K.: I'm on it. seeing repeated scale down/scale up loops in the metrics. CPU spikes then nodes drain.
Elena (oncall): taking lead for mitigation — will pause autoscaler and switch traffic to fallback pool (dedicated-eu-2) if safe. Handing off from Priya.
Priya K.: handoff acknowledged. grabbing rough customer impact now.
Samir: quick note — console shows 5xx spikes on generation endpoints and elevated queue times ~1.2s per request for affected pool. APAC not impacted.
Maya: marking this as region-scoped. customers with pinned capacity to dedicated-eu-1 might see degraded throughput. Non-pinned hosted API unaffected.
Ben (inccomm): need a short status update for external customers. Draft suggestion below — please edit.
Ben (inccomm): ```We are investigating elevated error rates and increased request latency affecting a subset of Dedicated EU capacity (eu-1). Our engineering team is actively mitigating and will provide updates every 30 minutes. Impact: intermittent failed requests and slower responses for apps using pinned eu-1 capacity. Next update: in ~30 minutes.```
Elena (oncall): looks good. change 'failed requests' -> 'intermittent 5xx responses' and add ETA for mitigation: 'attempting autoscaler pause and traffic reroute; estimated 15-30m for initial mitigation.'
Ben (inccomm): updated draft: ```We are investigating intermittent 5xx responses and increased request latency affecting a subset of Dedicated EU capacity (eu-1). Our engineering team is attempting an autoscaler pause and traffic reroute to a healthy pool; estimated 15–30 minutes for initial mitigation. Customers with pinned eu-1 capacity may experience degraded throughput until routing completes. Next update: in ~30 minutes or on status change.```
Samir: can Ops do the reroute now?
OpsDeployBot: Reroute job queued: reroute-dedicated-eu1->eu2 by Elena. Use `/ops deploy reroute reroute-dedicated-eu1` to proceed. Confirmation required.
Elena (oncall): executing now — running command: `/ops deploy reroute reroute-dedicated-eu1`
Priya K.: logs while reroute kicks: ```May 12 08:10:03 autoscaler: scale_down candidate chosen: node-57
May 12 08:10:05 autoscaler: scale_up triggered: node-58
May 12 08:10:15 routing: draining connections on node-57 -> 24 active connections
May 12 08:10:27 reroute: success: traffic shifted 60% to dedicated-eu-2```
Maya: nice, seeing latency drop trend in grafana for requests hitting eu-1 now. 5xx count decreasing.
Ben (inccomm): publishing initial status update to status page and pinging customers on impacted commit tiers. Draft final: ```Incident: Intermittent 5xx responses and elevated latency in Dedicated EU (eu-1)Impact: Some customers with pinned eu-1 capacity may have experienced higher latency and occasional failed requests.Scope: Region-specific — EU dedicated capacity only.Timeline: Alert raised 2026-05-12 08:02Z; mitigation action (traffic reroute commenced) 2026-05-12 08:10Z; initial mitigation showing improvement at 08:12Z.Action: Engineering is monitoring and will confirm when fully resolved. Next update in 30 minutes.```
Elena (oncall): please include note about 'no data exfiltration or config changes' for customers worried about security.
Ben (inccomm): added: "No customer data was accessed or exfiltrated as part of this incident." Updated draft ready.
Priya K.: internal note — root cause looks like aggressive downscale considerations from an autoscaler regression hitting certain CPU patterns. We'll follow up with postmortem. For now keep comms focused on impact and mitigation.
Samir: agree. Ops: keep reroute until autoscaler patch deployed.
Elena (oncall): setting a temporary rule: hold autoscaler in 'manual' for eu-1 until patch. Leaving reroute live.
OpsDeployBot: Autoscaler hold applied to pool dedicated-eu-1 by Elena.
Ben (inccomm): publishing now. @channel status page update posted and customers emailed per incident template. I'll paste the published copy once live.
Ben (inccomm): Published update link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/dedicated-eu-1-2026-05-12 — (drafted copy pasted above).
Priya K.: monitoring for reappearance; will escalate to oncall-ENG if 5xx resurges.
Maya: 5xx rate now down to baseline. Latency trending back to normal.
Ben (inccomm): Preparing resolved notice draft in case we hit full recovery: ```Resolved: Traffic has been rerouted and autoscaler has been placed on hold for the affected Dedicated EU pool (eu-1). Error rates and latency have returned to normal metrics. No customer data was accessed or exfiltrated. We will follow up with a post-incident report that includes root cause and remediation.```
Elena (oncall): hold off publish until 30m observation window completes. If stable, we'll publish resolved at ~08:42Z.
Priya K.: copy. I'll mark for postmortem and include autoscaler regression details and rollout blocks.
Ben (inccomm): noted. tagging CS to prepare direct outreach for top customers with pinned eu-1 capacity.
Elena (oncall): closing handoff — I'll update here when we publish resolved.
OpsDeployBot: Autoscaler hold will be removed by Elena after manual verification or via `/ops deploy remove-hold dedicated-eu-1`.
Ben (inccomm): Thanks team. leaving a note to include explicit customer guidance in post-incident email about pinning best-practices and recommended fallback configs.
Elena (oncall): published resolved notice at 2026-05-12T08:44:22Z — updating thread and status page now.
Ben (inccomm): Verified status page shows 'resolved' and sent follow-up email to impacted customers. Closing communications for now; will reopen thread if regression seen.
